summary: Flarum is open-source forum software designed for hosting online community discussions. Written in PHP, it provides a straightforward platform for user-generated threads and replies under an MIT licence. It targets the traditional bulletin board category of web applications.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you want to run a lightweight community discussion board using a standard PHP hosting stack.
watchOut: Community software in this category often requires ongoing moderation effort and plugin management, and it may overlap heavily with larger, more established alternatives.
deployNotes: You will typically need to provision a compatible PHP environment alongside a relational database such as MySQL or PostgreSQL, sitting behind a standard web server configured with TLS.
